_about: Example policy for a social media content creator. Illustrative, not a tested configuration.
Layout: Content/<YYYY-MM-DD> <slug>/{Raw,Edit,Export,Thumbnail}/ — the folder date is the planned posting date.
No calendar is strictly needed for posts: the date in the folder name opens the window.
A 'deals' calendar adds brand-deal review dates; a Finder tag 'Evergreen' marks reusable B-roll.

rules.note: Logos, fonts, colour palettes: small and used daily.
Tiny; handy when re-posting or answering comments.
B-roll you reuse every week stays local regardless of age.
A post folder dated 2026-11-12 is local from 5 Nov to 15 Nov: shoot, edit, post, first replies.
Sponsor review rounds need the exact cut at hand.
Exports stay a month for cross-posting to other platforms.
